chosen_by: agent (only axis with no prior rows in the ledger)
written_for: a structural geologist reviewing why these three rasters differ from the incumbent

parent.rebuild: pixel-identical from d2.8 at Euclidean catalogue distance > 2 px

instrument.recipe: whole-component hide-and-recover, every arm rebuilt fold-clean from d2.8 against the VISIBLE catalogue

calibration.mass_anchor: d1.5 60,069 dots 0.2477 -> d2.8 44,090 dots 0.2600 (both CLAIM, both catalogue-free)
calibration.prune_anchor_check: fold-clean d28->R0 proxy +0.002143 vs live +0.0178 — reproduces the PRUNE session's +0.00214 exactly

instrument.honest_limit: proxy deltas are compressed 3-5x relative to live; the scaled numbers are MODEL on PROXY and every one is under 0.01, i.e. below the brief's evidence bar

cards.variant: MASS -10 % by structural rank: 3,765 dots removed, 33,889 dots left (10.00 % of parent dots changed)
cards.hypothesis: The weakest mass in R0 is the speckle: dots sitting on tiny bridged structures (< 8 px) that a lineament cannot explain. Removing it saves alpha without losing credit.
cards.mechanism: The H19-5 field is 121,131 support pixels in 26,645 raw fragments; after bridging 1-px gaps it is 10,767 structures. 28.3 % of R0's dots sit on structures under 30 px, which is the scale of single-channel noise in a 400 m-spaced aeromagnetic survey rather than a fault trace. Each such dot pays alpha*(1-k) and credits truth only if truth happens to sit under it.
cards.mimic: A genuine short fault (a 200-400 m antithetic break, or a mapped trace truncated by the 100 m raster) is also a small structure. If the label set contains many short faults, this deletion removes real truth and the sign flips.
cards.falsifier: If live >= 0.2878 (+0.010) the speckle was pure waste and a second, larger extent cut is the best next slot. If live is within +-0.003 of R0, structural rank carries no information at 10 % and the ranking idea is dead.

cards.variant: MASS -10 % uniformly at random: 3,765 dots removed, 33,889 dots left (10.00 % changed)
cards.hypothesis: Control. Same mass removed, no ranking. The difference from mass-m10e is the value of the ranking, not of the mass.
cards.mechanism: Uniform deletion removes crediting and non-crediting dots in proportion to their abundance. With roughly 8 % of dots delivering credit, a 10 % uniform cut costs about 300 crediting dots and saves about 3,465 wasteful ones; the metric's beta = 0.8 weights the loss more heavily than the saving, so the net is negative.
cards.mimic: None — this arm is deliberately blind to geology. Its only failure mode is that it is a single draw; the seed is fixed and logged so the file is reproducible.
cards.falsifier: If this arm beats mass-m10e, the structural ranking is actively harmful and must be abandoned. If both arms beat R0, mass is the dominant lever and the final file should be chosen by a mass sweep alone.

cards.variant: MASS +10 %: 3,765 dots added at d > 300 m from the catalogue and >= 2.2 px from every existing dot, 41,419 dots (10.00 % changed)
cards.hypothesis: The lineage has cut mass at every rung since 121,131 pixels. If the field still holds real structure that the 37,654-dot budget never used, adding back a tenth should pay.
cards.mechanism: Only 31 % of the H19-5 support is dotted. The undotted support is not empty: it is the flanks and continuations of the same lineaments. DTI credits each truth pixel once, so a new dot pays only where the nearest existing dot is more than 3 px away in kernel terms - which is why the added dots had to go at 2.2 px spacing inside structures the field already draws, not at 2.8 px (only 794 cells exist at that separation).
cards.mimic: Denser sampling of a non-fault linear feature - a drainage, a basalt flow margin, a shoreline - buys nothing and pays alpha twice. This is the same mimic that governs the whole field, and this arm makes it more expensive.
cards.falsifier: If live >= 0.2878 the field was mass-starved and the remaining headroom (+14.3 % is the hard ceiling: only 5,383 free cells exist at d > 2 px) should be spent before any new signal. If live <= 0.2728 the mass plateau is confirmed from above and every future variant must change WHERE mass is, not how much.
